What is the role about?

As a Senior Software Engineer in our Meter Data Management (MDM) team, you will combine hands-on software development with technical ownership for a performance-critical product.
MDM covers the collection, validation, processing, and management of energy meter data. Our software processes large data volumes and supports critical customer and operational processes within the ZONOS ecosystem.

You will also contribute to migrations between customer systems, ensuring reliable data transfer, validation, integration, and system transition.


Your Role at a Glance

  • Provide technical direction and guide decisions from requirements through reliable delivery.
  • Own solution design, APIs, integrations, data flows, non-functional requirements, and technical risks within the team’s scope.
  • Develop and improve scalable software for high-volume, performance-critical data processing.
  • Guide migrations between customer systems, including data transfer, validation, reconciliation, and cutover activities.
  • Coordinate technical dependencies between Product, Platform, Operations, QA, DevOps, Security, and Architecture.
  • Facilitate design discussions, code reviews, technical workshops, and Architecture Decision Records.
  • Define and promote standards for performance, data quality, testing, maintainability, and operational reliability.
  • Support profiling, benchmarking, load testing, monitoring, and performance optimisation.
  • Contribute to backlog refinement, technical estimation, feasibility assessments, and release readiness.
  • Support CI/CD, observability, secure development, and ISO 27001 requirements.
  • Coach and support engineers through knowledge sharing, onboarding, mentoring, and constructive technical feedback.
  • Evaluate suitable agentic AI and AI-assisted engineering solutions while maintaining security and quality standards.


Must-haves (to thrive in this role)

  • University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a comparable discipline.
  • Several years of hands-on software development experience with technical ownership in a product or complex software environment.
  • Strong knowledge of software design, APIs, integrations, data processing, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with scalable or performance-critical software and large-volume data processing.
  • Experience with migrations between customer systems or complex software environments.
  • Ability to structure incomplete requirements, evaluate trade-offs, and guide technical decisions.
  • Experience with technical design, code reviews, testing, performance optimisation, and reliable delivery.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to align different technical contributors.
  • Professional English; German is an advantage.
  • Additional relevant degree or vocational qualification is welcome; equivalent practical experience is equally valued.


Nice-to-haves (great if you have them, but not a dealbreaker)

  • Experience with Java or Kotlin.
  • Experience with Kafka, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Oracle, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, or webhooks.
  • Experience in smart metering, energy, utilities, MDM, or Head-End Systems.
  • Experience with data migration tools, reconciliation processes, or Architecture Decision Records.
  • Experience with agentic AI or AI-assisted software development.


What You Bring to the Team

You will shape the technical direction of a product where performance, data quality, and reliability genuinely matter. You will influence architecture and delivery, support complex customer migrations, and help engineers grow through technical guidance and collaboration.
The role offers technical leadership and visible ownership without disciplinary management responsibility.

We are looking for a Senior IT Infrastructure & Cloud Engineer to own and improve Cuculus’ IT infrastructure, Jira Cloud administration, Linux systems, operational security, and transition from VM-based hosting to Microsoft Azure.

This role combines hands-on infrastructure operations with architecture, automation, security, and cloud migration responsibilities. The successful candidate will help build a reliable, secure, and increasingly cloud-based IT environment.


Your Role at a Glance

Azure & cloud migration

  • Lead the migration of selected virtual machines and services to Microsoft Azure.
  • Design and maintain Azure infrastructure, including virtual networks, virtual machines, storage, identity, monitoring, backup, access controls, and cost management.
  • Establish infrastructure-as-code and automation using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

  • Plan and perform operating system upgrades, security updates, patching, hardening, and lifecycle management.
  • Monitor infrastructure health, capacity, availability, backups, performance, and security vulnerabilities.
  • Establish reliable backup, restore, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity procedures.
Jira Cloud & Microsoft 365
  • Administer and govern Jira Cloud, including projects, workflows, permissions, roles, automations, integrations, marketplace applications, and license usage.
  • Support Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration, including identity, access, MFA, RBAC, and integrations.
Network & security
  • Maintain secure connectivity, DNS, certificates, VPNs, firewalls, reverse proxies, and internal network services.
  • Support security monitoring, logging, incident investigation, vulnerability remediation, and operational security controls.
Support & documentation
  • Provide advanced technical support and act as the escalation point for complex infrastructure and access issues.
  • Document systems, dependencies, maintenance procedures, architecture decisions, and recovery processes.
  • Coordinate with vendors and external service providers where required.


Must-haves (to thrive in this role)

Experience & education

  • Several years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud engineering, or IT operations.
  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or an equivalent qualification.
Azure & cloud migration
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, especially Azure VMs, networking, storage, monitoring, backup, Entra ID, RBAC, and security controls.
  • Experience planning or executing cloud and infrastructure migrations.
Linux, infrastructure & security
  • Strong Linux administration experience, preferably with Ubuntu, Debian, or Red Hat-based systems.
  • Practical experience with virtualization, Docker, networking, DNS, TLS certificates, SSH, firewalls, and backup systems.
  • Strong understanding of patch management, least-privilege access, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and secure system design.
Tools & automation
  • Experience administering Jira Cloud and integrating Jira with other systems through APIs, webhooks, or automation.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible.
How you work
  • Ability to troubleshoot independently and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Strong documentation and change-management habits.
Location & language
  • You can work on site at one of our offices in Ilmenau, Erfurt or Leipzig, especially during your first months.
  • Our company language is English - good English skills are a must.


Nice-to-haves (great if you have them, but not a dealbreaker)

Tools & platforms

  • Keycloak, LDAP, or other identity platforms.
  • MDM or endpoint-management systems.
  • GitLab, CI/CD, container orchestration, or internal developer platforms.
  • SIEM, log collection, monitoring, and alerting systems.
  • Jira Service Management or Confluence administration.
Frameworks & certifications
  • ITIL, ISO 27001, GDPR, or other security/compliance frameworks.
